verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is a first-party CI/CD feature. Workflows are written in YAML with GitHub Actions-compatible syntax, existing Actions can be reused, and Gitea ships an official action runner. That covers pipelines-as-code; automatic runs on push and pull request events are implied by the GitHub Actions workflow compatibility rather than stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of push/pull-request triggers and of where workflow files live in the repo, and independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions running pipelines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define CI/CD pipelines as code in my repository and have them run automatically on pushes and pull requests

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
Reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions inside your Gitea instances.
